headline: TPL Plastech Limited: Scheme of Arrangement
sum: Scheme of Arrangement - TPL Plastech Limited has informed the Exchange about the approval of the scheme of amalgamation (merger by absorption) of the Company with TTL and their respective shareholders and creditors.
